Gain 4, Work 2, Harm 2

Case: normal use - running the existing worker recovery tests.
Forwarding the configured budget now puts `gpt-6-luna` into the SDK's agent definitions for the fixture in tests/test_claude_worker_recovery.py:23. That test still asserts at line 77 that this value appears nowhere in the serialized options, so both its new-client and previous-adoption cases fail. findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Test.
Case: normal use - a Claude lite fix has a helper pair different from build, or a design task retries after failure.
Every custom-budget case configures only build and runs BOARD/HELP; the design case runs only once with defaults. Hard-coding the worker's budget lookup to build would pass these assertions while ignoring lite settings. Likewise, selecting fix's budget on a design retry would escape coverage. Extend this command-level test with distinct kind budgets and a design failure retry to protect item 6's per-kind selection and unchanged helper settings.
